session_note: Cloud-agent session on branch cursor/semaev-2015-audit-program-5b8b, 2026-09-13, on user instruction to add a Nagao pursuit. Fetched to settle one question with a checked source instead of an author's assertion: Section 7 of Nagao 2015/984 credits the DISJOINT (coset) factor base to this paper and says Galbraith-Gebregiyorgis ePrint 2014/806 'recently re-discovered' it. This program's mechanism lane (H-SEMBIN-c59e50) was built on 2014/806, so its novelty language depends on whose construction it is. IDEA-20260913-352163 recorded the priority question as unsettled and listed this paper as an unread pointer carrying no weight.

what_this_provenance_does_not_assert: Anything about who invented the disjoint factor base. The frozen text's own title and abstract are a decomposition formula for the Jacobian group of a plane curve, and its revision note records that the first version's Proposition 3 'is not true'; whether a coset-typed factor base for the elliptic case appears in these bytes at all is exactly the question a reader must answer, and this file must not be read as having answered it.
